topography.project_purpose: Prediction Market. Structurally: 26 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 3 ERC1155 multi-tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 9 common project-authored base contract(s) (accesscontrolupgradeable, contextupgradeable, erc165upgradeable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
